sections.overview: A marine snailfish known from the Crozet Basin near the southwest Indian Ridge.
sections.identification: The description notes tan coloration and a vertical gill slit about as long as the eye.
sections.habitat: It has been collected in deep oceanic waters, but the available record does not establish a full depth range.
sections.diet: The consulted species accounts do not describe its diet.
sections.behavior: Species-specific behavior is not documented in the consulted accounts.
sections.reproduction: The consulted accounts report no reproductive observations.
sections.ecology: The species is named for ichthyologist David L. Stein; its known ecological record is limited. Its Crozet Basin congener P. microps is named for its very small eyes, in contrast to the tan coloration noted for this species.
sections.conservation: FishBase lists the species as not evaluated by the IUCN.
